title: Dave Digger Bot
blurb: Dig through the dirt, grab the diamonds, and throw chickens at the bots.
controls: arrows dig, z throws a chicken

title: Bunny Quest
blurb: Explore the world, find the hidden axe and sword, beat the evil turtles, visit the villagers and catch the bunny.
controls: arrows walk, x swings, z knocks / talks / sleeps / switches weapon

title: Super Animals
blurb: Pick a cheetah, dragon, unicorn, snail or penguin and race the evil monster boss to the ultra diamond.
controls: left/right picks an animal, z jumps, x uses its power

title: Super Animals 2
blurb: Super Animals for two players. Each picks an animal and both race the boss to the ultra diamond. If you get hurt or left behind you float to the other player in a bubble. Stand still while touching the other player and you ride along with them.
controls: player 1: arrows, z jumps, x power. player 2: s/f/e/d, tab jumps, q power (or a second controller). z pops your bubble

title: Princess Lucille
blurb: Find the doggies on the rainbow platforms. Zap Maldrid the evil wizard with your wand and hide in your pink tent.
controls: arrows move, z jumps, x waves the wand

title: Rainbow Unicorn
blurb: Hop the rainbow blocks, grab the coins, and hide from the robber in your fort.
controls: arrows move, z jumps, x throws a star

title: Apple Guy vs the Duck
blurb: Jump the platforms, catch the diamond robots, and throw poison apples at the duck.
controls: arrows move, z jumps, x throws an apple, down drops through

title: Animal Power
blurb: One of our first games, from before Claude: I wrote the code from YouTube tutorials and the kids did the art.

title: Dave Digger Bot design notes
blurb: Not a game: Abel's design notes for Dave Digger Bot, typed into the PICO-8 code editor ("he throws chickens at them / the chicken needs to be smaller").
